papers.title: Adaptive conformal classification with noisy labels
papers.abstract: This paper develops novel conformal prediction methods for classification tasks that can automatically adapt to random label contamination in the calibration sample, leading to more informative prediction sets with stronger coverage guarantees compared to state-of-the-art approaches. This is made possible by a precise characterization of the effective coverage inflation (or deflation) suffered by standard conformal inferences in the presence of label contamination, which is then made actionable through new calibration algorithms. Our solution is flexible and can leverage different modeling assumptions about the label contamination process, while requiring no knowledge of the underlying data distribution or of the inner workings of the machine-learning classifier. The advantages of the proposed methods are demonstrated through extensive simulations and an application to object classification with the CIFAR-10H image data set.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决分类任务中标签噪声导致的标准共形推断覆盖率偏差问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应共形分类算法，利用标签污染过程的建模假设调整校准。
summary_zh.result: 相比现有方法，生成的预测集更信息丰富且覆盖保证更强。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟实验和CIFAR-10H图像数据集验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address coverage inflation/deflation in conformal prediction caused by label contamination in calibration data.
summary_en.method: Develops adaptive conformal classification algorithms that leverage modeling assumptions about label noise to calibrate prediction sets.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods yield more informative prediction sets with stronger coverage guarantees than state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation via extensive simulations and application to the CIFAR-10H image classification dataset.
